description: §4.12.2 (S445 item 3) — a session attribute on a nested `<program>` (here a scoped-db program under a `<div>` inside the application program) is E-PROGRAM-NESTED-SESSION, once per offending attribute. The session cookie is application-scope (§20.5.1); before S445 the nested `session-secure="false" sessionExpiry="30d"` reached the step-2 last-wins read and the application minted plain `scrml_sid` / Max-Age=2592000 with no diagnostic (g-two-programs-one-file-session-attr-last-wins).
rationale: §4.12.2 (S445 item 3): 'A session attribute on a nested `<program>` SHALL be a compile error (`E-PROGRAM-NESTED-SESSION`), whatever its value.'
